thread:
leo: quick check: cohort sizing & prioritization for DP wave. We're leaning to 10 partners mixed hosted + private, 6-week. Need to finalize selection criteria and launch gating.

hana: Criteria proposal: 40% existing paid hosted customers, 30% mid-market (on-prem interest), 20% new logos, 10% experimental (edge cases). Also prioritize customers with a product owner committed.

priya: Important to capture "integration owner" contact in intake. Without one we get stalled. Also let's define "launch-ready" gating: integration complete, perf baselined, 2-week negative drift < 5%, legal signoff if required.

ops-bot: Note from infra: private deploy capacity peaks Mon/Wed for 2-hour windows; ops recommends running smoke tests in those windows.

leo: Good to know. Stagger start dates around Mon/Wed windows. Also, let's set a max of 4 private concurrent sessions to be safe.

hana: Success metrics: tech: p95 tokens < 350ms hosted, p95 private < 450ms; qualitative: partner satisfaction survey >= 8; business: 2 partners with product roadmap commitments post-beta.

priya: Recruitment incentives: $X credits + priority support + case study offer. Solutions can provide 4x engineering hours as grant for top 2 partners.

leo: Legal flag: one regulated partner in shortlist, need to loop legal-bot for DPA and on-prem checklist.

legal-bot: @leo please submit redwood-legal intake; turnaround est 5 business days for DPA review. Marking partner as "pending-legal".

priya: Feedback cadence: weekly sync, and run an automated eval suite weekly with deterministic prompts plus a partner-provided suite. Capture diffs in the eval dashboard.

hana: Also recommend a "quality lead" for each partner (rotating) to triage issues and close P1/P2 within 48h. Without this SLA risk of stalled beta is high.

leo: Stop criteria: if more than 50% partners report blocker-level issues for >1 week, pause rollout and run a 2-week remediation sprint.

ops-bot: Reminder: reserve 1 emergency private slot per week for hotfix validation.

priya: Action items: 1) priya: update intake with "integration owner" + legal flag (due Fri) 2) hana: finalize success metric thresholds and survey (due Mon) 3) leo: confirm shortlist and send invites (due Tue) 4) ops-bot: reserve private slots (ongoing).

leo: thanks. will pull this into a one-pager and share in the recruitment channel. :rocket:
